The paper declares this appendix at 31 pages with the hash above. It was sought in the custodian's repository on 2026-08-30 and is not there: none of the four files held matches the hash and none is 31 pages. Those four are seated as related captures under their own identities and are NOT presented as the appendix. Until it is located, the determinations at §4.3 and §10.1 rest on a document no reader can open. A file is not labelled as evidence it is not — which is the condition this paper measures.

determinability: Every claim in the paper is determinable from the display layer preserved in the evidentiary appendix. The paper states this as a design requirement (§4.2, evidence scope) and declines to assert anything about the full body text of the four cited documents (§4.3.2, §10.1 1c).
